summary: Iter 215au — Full regression sweep for drawer-based org management UI. All 17 tests PASSED. The inline org expansion has been successfully converted to a unified right-side slide-in drawer with 6 tabs (Details, Users, Features, Sites, Billing, Audit). All existing testids preserved. Mobile view works correctly with full-width drawer.

integration_issues.issue: Command Palette opens correctly but org search results may not trigger drawer opening - selectedOrg prop not being consumed by AdminOrganizations. This is a pre-existing issue, not introduced in 215au.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Wire up selectedOrg prop in AdminOrganizations to auto-open drawer when org is selected via Command Palette
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 215au drawer implementation verified working. All 4 existing buttons (Edit, Users, Features, Sites) open the drawer with correct tab pre-selected. Two NEW tabs added: Billing (shows tier/status/customer account/sage ref) and Audit (fetches /api/master-admin/audit-log with org filter, shows events with kind/timestamp/summary/actor). Drawer closes via Escape and backdrop click. Save Details flow works with 'Saved HH:MM' chip and 1.5s auto-close. All row testids preserved. Mobile view (390x844) shows full-width drawer with horizontally scrollable tabs.

drawer_open_edit_btn.details: org-edit-{id} click opens drawer with Details tab (org-details-panel-{id})

drawer_open_users_btn.details: org-users-btn-{id} click opens drawer with Users tab (org-users-panel-{id})

drawer_open_features_btn.details: org-features-{id} click opens drawer with Features tab

drawer_open_sites_btn.details: org-sites-{id} click opens drawer with Sites tab

tab_switching.details: All 6 tabs clickable: org-tab-details-{id}, org-tab-users-{id}, org-tab-features-{id}, org-tab-sites-{id}, org-tab-billing-{id}, org-tab-audit-{id}

billing_tab.details: org-billing-panel-{id} shows tier/status selects and org-billing-account-{id}, org-billing-sage-{id} inputs

audit_tab.details: org-audit-panel-{id} fetches /api/master-admin/audit-log?organization_id={id}&since_days=30&limit=50, shows org-audit-list with org-audit-event-{idx} items containing kind, timestamp, summary, actor

drawer_close_escape.details: Escape key closes drawer and resets expandedOrg to null

save_details_flow.details: Modify Notes → click org-save-details-btn → org-edit-saved-chip appears → drawer auto-closes after 1.5s → filter state preserved (no page reload)

add_user_flow.details: org-add-user-btn-{id} opens add user form inside Users tab

bulk_select.details: org-select-{id} checkboxes show org-bulk-actions bar with org-bulk-archive, org-bulk-activate, org-bulk-toggle-test, org-bulk-clear

more_dropdown.details: org-more-{id} opens dropdown with org-archive-{id}, org-test-{id}, org-email-preview-{id}

archive_undo_banner.details: Archive action shows org-archive-undo-banner with org-archive-undo-btn and org-archive-undo-dismiss

row_testids_preserved.details: All preserved: org-card-{id}, org-tier-{id}, org-status-{id}, org-edit-{id}, org-features-{id}, org-sites-{id}, org-archive-{id}, org-test-{id}, org-email-preview-{id}, org-more-{id}, org-select-{id}

mobile_view.details: 390x844 viewport: drawer full-width (390px), all 6 tabs visible and scrollable, Audit tab loads events
